name: Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor
source:
Christopher Ledger: Corporate Auditor is a courtroom-style visual novel about corporate murder, fraud, cover-ups, and the billion-dollar scandals hiding in plain sight in every corner office.

You play as Christopher Ledger, an auditor investigating shady corporations - cross-examining executives, tracing evidence, and unraveling conspiracies one contradiction at a time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4505740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《克里斯托弗·莱杰：企业审计师》是一款法庭辩论风格的视觉小说，聚焦企业谋杀、财务欺诈、黑幕掩盖，以及公然潜藏在一间间高管办公室里的十亿美元级惊天丑闻。

你将扮演企业审计师克里斯托弗·莱杰，深入调查黑幕重重的无良企业——当庭盘问公司高管、追查蛛丝马迹，从一处处证言矛盾中抽丝剥茧，彻底瓦解庞大的阴谋网络。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4505740/]Steam[/url]]
